title: Review Verification Receipt (v1)
description: PR-level marker recording an INDEPENDENT verification of a fix/refutation. Embedded in a PR issue comment as `<!-- verification:v1 {json} -->` and posted by scripts/reviews/run verify. The verifier MUST differ from the writer set (PR author + disposers); scripts/reviews/run refuses to post otherwise (write-side), and the check-pr-review-convergence closeout re-checks it (read-side) via verification_receipt_head_match (#3693 R1). `status` is reserved (v1 verification is a point-in-time result, not a long-running job); when present, `running` marks an in-flight verification.

head.description: The PR headRefOid this verification ran against.

verifier.description: Identity of the independent verifier (must be outside the writer set).

findings.description: Count of findings, or a structured findings object.

status.description: Reserved. Absent means a completed point-in-time verification.
